sn48.39:6.1: Experience depends on the collision of disparate elements, whose friction or “resistance” (_paṭigha_, [dn15:20.4]()) sparks the light of consciousness. Hence consciousness, like fire, is beautiful but also burning ([sn35.28]()). | This simile is also found at [mn140:19.13](), [sn12.62:4.1](), and [sn36.10:1.10]().
